title: Now, Lord, the Heavenly Seed Is Sown
description: Now, Lord, the Heavenly Seed Is Sown in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 87 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “"God giveth the Increase."”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Now, Lord, the heav-enly seed is sown, Be it thy ser-vants' care Thy heav-enly bless-ing to bring down By hum-ble, fer-vent prayer.

lines: Now, Lord, the heavenly seed is sown,
Thy heavenly blessing to bring down
In vain we plant without thine aid,
Lord of the harvest, God of grace,
Then shall our cheerful hearts and tongues
"Thou, Lord, hast given the rich increase,

licence: Public domain: anonymous words in print by 1853.
credits: Words anonymous, public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
